Canidelo is today one of the most coveted areas in the North region, precisely because of its fusion between nature and urban accessibility. The surroundings are rich in green spaces and pedestrian paths, with emphasis on:

- Proximity to marinas, international schools, supermarkets, gyms, cafes and restaurants
